description: This Kotlin source file defines the `TransferHistoryRepository` class, which manages access to transfer history records, including observing, logging, updating, and deleting transfer entries within the app's data layer.

classes.name: TransferHistoryRepository
classes.description: A repository class that provides methods to observe and modify transfer history data such as logging new transfers, marking transfers complete, and deleting records.

methods.name: history
methods.description: An observable flow of all transfer history records.

methods.name: historyForConnection
methods.description: Returns a flow of transfer history records filtered by a specific connection ID.

methods.name: logTransferStart
methods.description: Logs a new transfer initiation with status 'IN_PROGRESS' and records the start timestamp.

methods.name: markTransferComplete
methods.description: Updates a transfer record's status to 'SUCCESS' or 'FAILED', sets completion timestamp, byte count, and error message if applicable.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a transfer history record from the database by its ID.
